name: – Nils Ušakovs – After § 30 – Am 41
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 30a. Stresses that the financing of the EU budget should remain primarily based on contributions from Member States, in line with the principles of subsidiarity, fiscal responsibility and national budgetary sovereignty; expresses concern that the introduction of new own resources will increase the overall fiscal burden on citizens and businesses across the EU;
